    strftime('%m', order_date) AS month,
    SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) AS sales
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND order_date LIKE '2026-%'
GROUP BY strftime('%m', order_date)
ORDER BY month

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '10' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) = '09' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END)) AS sales_change
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND order_date LIKE '2026-%'

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN o.id ELSE NULL END) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.id as category_id,
    c.name as category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) as gross_profit
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY 
    c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 
    gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
